note: Launch risks for the pre-mortem (api/src/premortem.ts). 'launch' rules are our own rules of thumb, not fitted to outcome data yet. 'gate' fixes go with the token rules in rules.json: what a builder can change so the gate stops objecting.

launch.plain: A sell tax over 10% keeps a big share of every exit. Buyers read it as a trap.
launch.fix: Keep the sell tax at 5% or less, or drop it.

launch.plain: A sell tax over 5% makes leaving costly.
launch.fix: Lower the sell tax to 5% or less.

launch.plain: A buy tax over 10% costs every new holder before the price moves.
launch.fix: Keep the buy tax at 5% or less.

launch.plain: Selling costs much more than buying. That is the shape of a honeypot.
launch.fix: Make buy and sell tax the same, or close to it.

launch.plain: The team holds over 20% of supply. One sale can sink the price.
launch.fix: Keep team tokens at 10% or less, and vest them.

launch.plain: The team holds over 10% of supply.
launch.fix: Lower the team share or lock it with a public vesting contract.

launch.plain: The liquidity is not locked. It can be pulled at any moment.
launch.fix: Lock the pool's liquidity with a public locker before launch.

launch.plain: The liquidity lock ends within a month.
launch.fix: Lock it for 90 days or more.

gateFixes.token_mint_live_owner: Remove the mint function, or renounce ownership before launch.
gateFixes.token_has_blacklist: Remove the blacklist function. Agents using Reinkeep will not buy a token that can freeze them.
gateFixes.token_has_pause: Remove the pause switch, or renounce the owner who can use it.
gateFixes.token_ticker_copy: Pick a ticker no earlier token uses.
gateFixes.token_low_liquidity: Start with at least $1,000 of liquidity.
gateFixes.token_facts_unknown: State every field of the draft so nothing is left unknown.
